ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-1,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 7-K in the area bound by:

a line 149.27 feet south of and parallel to West Barry Avenue; the alley next east of and
parallel to North Cicero Avenue; a line 249.27 feet south of and parallel to West Barry
Avenue; and North Cicero Avenue

to those of a B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

FelixCardgna Jr.
Alderman, 31%t Ward

Common Address:
3037-43 N Cicero Avenue
